title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E01 — Roadside Murder
Theresa Wesolowski, 22, is murdered on May 29, 1999; police are baffled for nearly 10 years before finally getting a break when a new DNA technique identifies Wesolowski's coworker, Mark Libecki, as her killer.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E02 — Deadly Delivery
Sandra Berfield suffers years of harassment from coworker Steven Caruso and has him jailed for violating a restraining order; released, Caruso sends a pipe bomb to Berfield who is killed instantly after picking up a package left on her front porch.

title: The Killer Beside Me
description:
S02 E05 — Flowers in the Lake
After Leesa Nascimento is shot dead, a recently fired coworker, Lorenza Sam, is tied to her murder and arrested.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S02 E01 — Tears for My Mother
A man calls 911 claiming he found his ex-girlfriend dead, but his behavior on the call leads police to wonder if he could be involved; investigators gather evidence to convict a killer whose unchecked rage left a young son motherless.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S03 E07 — Deadlift
A terrified neighbor calls 911 after witnessing a young mother being gunned down in her driveway; police work to uncover a complex conspiracy that ripped the loving mother from her three children, just to keep dark secrets hidden.

title: Murder Calls
description:
S03 E02 — The Slender Man
When a young woman is shot dead in front of her son, horrified witnesses call 911 and describe the shooter as a slender man who disappeared into nearby trees; though clues are scarce, investigators finally uncover the killer's shocking identity.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E08 — Stalking Carl
Thirty-six-year-old Carl Starke is shot dead in cold blood near his home in St. Augustine, Fla.; while there are no witnesses, neighbors hear shots; armed with a likely time of death, police turn to CCTV to help hunt down Starke's killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E10 — The Blood Trail
Tom and Jill Estes' bodies are found behind a dumpster in Festus, Mo.; police are baffled until a receipt leads to CCTV footage of a blood-stained suspect; a trail of bodies reveals a killer who must be stopped before he strikes again.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E03 — The Lady Vanishes
Sixty-nine-year old Ina Clare Richardson is found brutally murdered in a public park in Clarkston, Wash.; with no witnesses, investigators turn to surveillance cameras to piece together the puzzle of her fateful final night.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E04 — The Man in the Black Hat
Twenty-five-year-old student Julissa Brisman is found shot to death in a Boston hotel room; with no witnesses, investigators turn to surveillance cameras to find a serial attacker.

title: See No Evil
description:
S05 E11 — Gentle Giant
Fifty-one-year-old care worker Torrance Cheeves is found murdered in his San Antonio home; with no suspects and a trail of puzzling evidence, investigators turn to surveillance cameras in the surrounding area for answers.

title: Body Cam
description:
S10 E01 — Show Me Your Hands
In Colorado, a driver opens fire and sparks a chase; in Ohio, a man ignites a daylight shootout; in Florida, deputies race to find a missing boy.

title: Body Cam
description:

In Washington, officers come under fire when a domestic dispute turns violent.

title: Murder on Mount Baldy
description: Tragedy strikes a mountain community when a beloved resident, 71-year-old Jack Irwin, disappears without a trace.

A woman vanishes after a night out; the only clues left behind are suspicious drag marks outside her home; closed-circuit television footage reveals three different suspects on the scene.

title: See No Evil
description:
S04 E07 — Maurice's Last Visitor
Sixty-year-old social worker Francis "Maurice" Byrd is found dead in his home after being shot by an unknown assailant; security footage from the church opposite Byrd's house shows that he received many visitors prior to the discovery of his body.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E02 — Who Needs Enemies
A cold morning in December starts off like any other, then a farmer finds the body of a dead woman; what seems like a rape and murder case turns into a conspiracy, and someone's diabolical nature is soon revealed.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E05 — Queen of Deception
In Susanville, Calif., a beloved police officer is found dead in what looks like an apparent suicide, then detectives launch a full-blown murder investigation and zero in on the officer's wife as a possible suspect.

title: Diabolical
description:
S02 E07 — The Rich Get Richer
Penny Knell is admitted to a special care facility, where a devious mastermind is waiting to prey on vulnerable people; when Penny's family gets ensnared in her web, the consequences will be fatal.

title: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body
description:
S01 E02 — Sin City Secret
Las Vegas Detectives find themselves on the hunt of their careers as they try to track down those responsible for the horrific murder of a young woman after her body turns up in a concrete and wooden box in the middle of the desert.

title: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body
description:
S01 E03 — Graveyard Shift
Police find a murder victim inside a Civil War crypt in a historic cemetery in Southwest Philadelphia; detectives from two counties navigate the evils of a notorious motorcycle club to try and solve the case.

title: How (Not) to Get Rid of a Body
description:
S01 E06 — Needles in a Mineshaft
When a young couple goes missing in Eureka, Utah, detectives from neighboring counties work together to track down their killer and, with the help of a highly trained dive team, recover their bodies in an abandoned mineshaft.

title: Where Murder Lies
description:
S02 E04 — Enemy Inside the Gate
In 2007, Marilou Johnson's millionaire boyfriend, Roger Blanchard, reports her missing; police have little to go on in their search for the mother of three until a witness steps forward.

title: Where Murder Lies
description:
S02 E02 — Killer Cuts
The disappearance of a popular resident of Eastman, Ga., rocks the small town; as the search for Russell Ray intensifies, any hope of finding him alive dwindles after police make a horrific discovery.

title: Where Murder Lies
description:
S02 E01 — Monster of Deception
Single mother Brandi Peters and her three young children are brutally murdered inside their Tallahassee, Fla., home in November 2010; detectives are shocked to uncover a killer who is a real-life monster hiding in plain sight.

title: Where Murder Lies
description:
S02 E05 — Diabolical Devil
A religious community mourns an elderly couple after they turn up viciously murdered in their home; in a race to capture the killer, investigators discover that their deaths weave into a larger web of lies and wicked desires.

title: Murder Comes to Town
description:
S04 E01 — Wicked Witness
In Walsenburg, Colo., a frantic 911 call to help a neighbor ends in a bizarre investigation, complete with a twisted tale of torture and family secrets.

title: Murder Comes to Town
description:
S04 E04 — Who's Missing Now
In Marion, N.C., young waitress Zilpha Lowery goes missing, and foul play is suspected immediately; as rumors spread, Lowery's fate is linked to another mysterious disappearance.

title: Murder Comes to Town
description:
S04 E06 — Roses Are Red, Murder Is Too
In Berryville, Va., a town council member is found murdered in her home, and the only evidence left behind is the single bullet that took her life, making the slaying look more and more like a professional hit.

title: Murder Comes to Town
description:
S04 E10 — Dorothy Did Right
In Georgiana, Ala., a beloved church lady is murdered, sending the townspeople into a tailspin; rumors fly as detectives struggle to separate fact from fiction.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S09 E02 — Murder on the Mountain
After a young father goes missing from work, the small town of Challis, Idaho, is abuzz with tales of infidelity and finger-pointing, leaving investigators to decipher what is fact and what is fiction.

title: The Murder Tapes
description:
S05 E10 — The Drop Off
Ahmad Shad Laster's loved ones are grief-stricken when he is shot outside a friend's home; Flagler County, Fla., detectives uncover evidence that blows the case wide open, but the hunt for justice tests family bonds and reveals shocking secrets.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S08 E05 — Fractured Glass
When affable ladies' man Michael Tittemore is gunned down in the dead of night, Lt. Joe Kenda sets his sights on the roommates who were present during the murder; then, a revelation turns his attention to a far more nefarious band of suspects.

title: Hometown Homicide
description:
S02 E01 — Hold the Line

High school sweethearts Lisa and Jimmy Moore end their marriage, and Lisa goes missing three months later; fearing the worst, her family files a missing person report, but the police have no leads and no witnesses.

description:
S01 E02 — Smoke and Mirrors
Pastor David Allen loses his wife, Paula, in a fire at the parsonage; the fire marshal investigates and discovers there is more to this story than an accidental fire.

title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
description:
S02 E06 — The Executioner
In Oakland, Calif., detectives investigate after a boat distributor reports a possible yacht theft, and the resulting sting operation ensnares a master manipulator who has an unexpected day job and a voracious appetite for money and murder.

title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
description:
S02 E04 — Angel of Death
When a jilted lover storms into a provincial police station making wild accusations against her ex, one detective questions the credibility and motives of the wronged woman.

title: Pandora's Box: Unleashing Evil
description:
S02 E10 — Hate and Fury
After three synagogues go up in flames, federal agents work around the clock to solve the arsons; they get an unexpected break when a double murder 150 miles away reveals new evidence as well as a sinister plot fueled by bigotry.

title: Mean Girl Murders
description:
S02 E02 — Church Camp Killer
A group of girls begins lifelong friendships at church camp; as they become adults, life takes them down different roads through troubled relationships and unexpected pregnancies; their bonds remain until one of them disappears.

title: Mean Girl Murders
description:
S02 E03 — Girls in the Hoods
Social status is everything in junior high, so when Shanda Sharer arrives at her new school, she does her best to make new friends; she unknowingly enters into a relationship between a popular jock and the ruler of the clique known as the Hoods.

title: Mean Girl Murders
description:
S02 E10 — Built for Murder
Las Vegas is a playground for top female fitness competitors; winning is important, and when jealousy spirals out of control, one woman loses her life.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S01 E03 — Dirty Dancing
A single mother turns to exotic dancing to support her family; as she becomes successful, the temptation to make much more money leads to lies with devastating consequences; faced with an uncertain future, she stabs and kills her boyfriend.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S01 E06 — A Model Murder
An aspiring model, Kimberly Pandelios, accepts an offer to pose in lingerie for a mysterious photographer, then disappears; years later, a young woman contacts the police when she begins to suspect that her boyfriend may have been the killer.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S01 E04 — The Fall of Aubrey Gold
A missing person's report sends investigators on a desperate search through the seedy underbelly of the Floribama panhandle; all roads lead to a once sought-after porn star, whose fate is revealed when an informant comes forward to unearth the truth.

title: Lethally Blonde
description:
S01 E02 — The Porn Identity
All-American Midwestern hunk Timothy Boham's innocent modeling career catapults him into porn industry stardom; when Tim tries to escape the vicious cycle of selling his body for money, running from his past proves to be deadly.

title: Disappeared
description:
S11 E02 — Love and Lies in Idyllwild
Dia Abrams owns several properties in the Idyllwild community of California, including a sprawling 116-acre ranch; on June 6th, 2020, Dia tells her partner, Keith Harper, she will feed the horses and is never seen or heard from again.

title: Disappeared
description:
S11 E08 — Gone With the Night
Twenty-seven-year-old Gretchen Fleming is figuring out her life while living in her hometown of Parkersburg, W.V.; after a night out in town, Gretchen is last seen leaving a local bar with a mystery man and is never heard from again.

title: Disappeared
description:
S11 E04 — The Secrets of Bissonnet Street
On Jan. 2, 2020, 15-year-old Kristen Galvan disappears; her disappearance comes just one month after police rescued her from a sex-trafficking ring in Houston.

title: Disappeared
description:
S11 E10 — Mystery in the Ozarks
On May 19th 2022, Christopher Hoye suddenly left his Ozarks homestead; after several hours, Christopher's wife recovers his truck next to a dangerous river, but Christopher is gone; as weeks go by, there are more questions than answers.

title: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger
description:
S01 E02 — Lie, Cheat, Kill Evil
Hurricane Harvey hits Houston, realtor and mother Crystal McDowell disappear; with local resources strained and leads scarce, an abandoned car and a mysterious figure on surveillance prompt authorities to call in Texas Ranger Jim Holland for answers.

title: Body Cam
description:

In Florida, officers negotiate with a man brazenly wielding a machete as he takes a hostage. In Louisiana, a drug overdose call takes an unexpected turn. Also in Florida, deputies rush to save a mother and child from drowning in their submerged car.

description:

Detective Postiglione investigates a crime scene where pools of blood indicate that something terrible occurred, but the female victim is nowhere to be found; it's up to Postiglione to find her and a possible murderer.

description:

When the remains of a young mother are discovered in a remote area outside Nashville, Tenn., Detective Postiglione solves the crime by recalling a detail from the wooded scene and puts a dangerous murderer behind bars.

description:
S39 E10 — Joe Hunter's Mission
"Survivor" contestant Joe Hunter says his sister, whose death was officially ruled a suicide, was murdered.

title: 48 Hours
description:

After a wife calls 911 to report her husband missing, police discover his lifeless body in his car, parked inside a corporate parking garage.

title: 48 Hours
description:

The murders of a beloved doctor, his wife and their young daughter leave their Santa Barbara, Calif., community reeling; a manhunt leads to the arrest of a suspect who prosecutors say is a conman.

S02 E07 — Death and Denials

description:
S02 E09 — Lying Consequences
A man finds a mom dead in her bathtub and calls 911 in a panic, claiming an accident. Shocking testimony reveals the truth. Police send a 911 caller to prison for a deadly assault - but is he innocent?

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E03 — We Sell Babies
The Always Hope adoption center, run by Tara Lynn Lee, falls under suspicion of multiple families who are all left heartbroken after their adoptions fall through; the FBI begins to uncover a heartbreaking multi-state scam like no other.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E04 — Inside Job
In Connecticut, an employee arrives at his bank with a bomb strapped to him, claiming he will die if not given money; in Tennessee, bank employees begin robbing their own banks, each claiming they have been held hostage and forced into the crime.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E05 — Gangbuster
A series of unsolved shootings and murders across Southern Florida leave a community terrorized under the threat of an unknown gang; rookie FBI Special Agent Jessica Box makes it her mission to identify and dismantle this deadly crew.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E06 — Hired To Kill
Over two years, a killer shoots multiple people dead in Philadelphia; the killer's identity and motive remain unclear; the FBI and a dedicated task force soon uncover that they are dealing with a real-life hitman who calls himself the Real John Wick.

title: Toxic
description:
S01 E05 — Surviving Strangis
Elizabeth digs into convicted conman, Anthony Strangis; after unpacking his MO with Sarma, Elizabeth uncovers a string of alleged new victims; new revelations suggest Anthony Strangis is at it again and put Elizabeth hot on his trail.

title: Toxic
description:
S01 E06 — Chasing a Ghost
Elizabeth continues her quest for answers about convicted conman, Anthony Strangis. After speaking with his alleged victims, Elizabeth wants answers. After the trail goes cold, unexpected intelligence leads Elizabeth right to Anthony's front door.

title: Toxic
description:
S01 E01 — Sleeping With a Stranger
Elizabeth Chambers unravels the deception and manipulation that leads to the bloody ending of Kelly Sutcliffe's marriage, but a vicious attack is only the start of Kelly's nightmare; living in fear, Kelly turns to an unlikely source for protection.

title: Toxic
description:
S01 E03 — The Depraved Heart
Elizabeth meets with the Harris family to investigate the tragic loss of their beloved daughter, and sister, Sarah; what was supposed to be a routine dental visit for Sarah turned into a toxic and dangerous relationship with a well-respected surgeon.

title: Betrayed
description:
S02 E06 — Dying to Be Popular
Fifteen-year-old Becky Stowe is eager to find love, then she disappears without a trace, prompting friends and family to wonder if she found what she was looking for, or if trouble found her instead.

title: Betrayed
description:
S02 E01 — Hell on Wheels
Motorcycle-riding Diane Snellen is a single mother trying to make her way in the world while navigating the dating scene in Georgetown, Ky., then her life comes to an abrupt end when she's stabbed in her own home.
